description: Explicit nested restoration uses the witness capture without duplicating T (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x(candidate)
%conditions matches(without-elision($x), rival)
%rule candidate X [+T]
%rule rival $y(body)
%conditions matches(without-elision($y), inner)
%rule body X [+T]
%rule inner X [+T]
